phase2/simulate.pyStep 2 simulation engine · 176 lines
  1"""Phase 2 simulation engine. Local only: no network requests, no database access.
  2
  3A "world" is one plausible set of 24 true conversion rates, drawn from each arm's
  4Beta posterior. Every combination is run on the same worlds, so they are compared
  5fairly (paired). Pulls are simulated one at a time, exactly as the live driver
  6would make them; numpy runs many worlds side by side.
  7"""
  8import math
  9
 10import numpy as np
 11
 12K = 24     # Arms
 13V = 100    # Visitors per pull
 14CHUNK = 4096
 15
 16
 17def posterior(pulls, signups, prior=(1.0, 1.0)):
 18    """Beta(prior_a + sign-ups, prior_b + non-sign-ups) for each arm."""
 19    pulls = np.asarray(pulls, float)
 20    signups = np.asarray(signups, float)
 21    return prior[0] + signups, prior[1] + V * pulls - signups
 22
 23
 24def draw_worlds(a, b, reps, seed, stream):
 25    """reps x K true rates. Each stream is an independent set of worlds."""
 26    return np.random.default_rng([seed, stream]).beta(a, b, size=(reps, K))
 27
 28
 29def top_up(P, pulls, signups, per_arm, rng):
 30    """Uniform pulls until every arm has `per_arm` pulls.
 31
 32    Returns pulls (reps x K), sign-ups (reps x K), the expected sign-ups those
 33    uniform pulls earned per world, and how many pulls were added. Pull order
 34    within the uniform phase doesn't affect anything later, so each arm's extra
 35    sign-ups are drawn in one go.
 36    """
 37    extra = np.maximum(0, per_arm - np.asarray(pulls, int))
 38    n = np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(pulls, float) + extra, P.shape).copy()
 39    s = np.asarray(signups, float) + rng.binomial(V * extra, P)
 40    return n, s, (P * extra).sum(axis=1), int(extra.sum())
 41
 42
 43def checkpoints(start, horizon, count=40):
 44    if horizon <= start:
 45        return np.array([], int)
 46    return np.unique(np.geomspace(start + 1, horizon, count).astype(int))
 47
 48
 49def run_policy(kind, param, P, n, s, start, horizon, rng, trace=False, prior=(1.0, 1.0)):
 50    """Simulate pulls start..horizon-1 one at a time. Lane i uses param[i].
 51
 52    kind 'ucb': pull argmax of mean + param * sqrt(2 ln t / n), with t the pulls
 53                made so far. This is program/bandit's UCBModel with
 54                exploration = 2 * param**2. Ties go to the lowest arm.
 55    kind 'eps': with probability param, pull a uniformly random arm (any of the
 56                24); otherwise pull the arm with the highest mean.
 57    kind 'ts':  Thompson Sampling. Draw one rate from every arm's
 58                Beta(prior_a + sign-ups, prior_b + non-sign-ups) and pull the
 59                highest draw. param is ignored.
 60    """
 61    lanes = len(P)
 62    n, s = n.astype(float), s.astype(float)
 63    mu = s / (V * n)
 64    nf, sf, mf, Pf = n.reshape(-1), s.reshape(-1), mu.reshape(-1), P.reshape(-1)
 65    base = np.arange(lanes) * K
 66    param = np.asarray(param, float)
 67    if kind == 'ucb':
 68        isq = 1 / np.sqrt(n)
 69        qf = isq.reshape(-1)
 70        coef = (param * math.sqrt(2))[:, None]
 71    elif kind == 'ts':
 72        beta_a, beta_b = prior[0] + s, prior[1] + V * n - s
 73        af, bf = beta_a.reshape(-1), beta_b.reshape(-1)
 74    elif kind != 'eps':
 75        raise ValueError(kind)
 76
 77    best = P.max(axis=1)
 78    sum_p = np.zeros(lanes)
 79    marks = checkpoints(start, horizon)
 80    curve = np.zeros((len(marks), lanes))
 81    mark = 0
 82    log = {'arms': [], 'rewards': []} if trace else None
 83
 84    t = start
 85    while t < horizon:
 86        steps = min(CHUNK, horizon - t)
 87        if kind == 'eps':
 88            explore = rng.random((steps, lanes)) < param
 89            random_arm = rng.integers(0, K, (steps, lanes))
 90        for i in range(steps):
 91            if kind == 'ucb':
 92                arms = (mu + coef * math.sqrt(math.log(t)) * isq).argmax(axis=1)
 93            elif kind == 'ts':
 94                arms = rng.beta(beta_a, beta_b).argmax(axis=1)
 95            else:
 96                arms = np.where(explore[i], random_arm[i], mu.argmax(axis=1))
 97            flat = base + arms
 98            p = Pf[flat]
 99            sum_p += p
100            reward = rng.binomial(V, p)
101            pulls = nf[flat] + 1
102            nf[flat] = pulls
103            total = sf[flat] + reward
104            sf[flat] = total
105            mf[flat] = total / (V * pulls)
106            if kind == 'ucb':
107                qf[flat] = 1 / np.sqrt(pulls)
108            elif kind == 'ts':
109                af[flat] = prior[0] + total
110                bf[flat] = prior[1] + V * pulls - total
111            if trace:
112                log['arms'].append(int(arms[0]))
113                log['rewards'].append(int(reward[0]))
114            t += 1
115            if mark < len(marks) and t == marks[mark]:
116                curve[mark] = V * (best * (t - start) - sum_p)
117                mark += 1
118
119    lane = np.arange(lanes)
120    pick = mu.argmax(axis=1)
121    true_best = P.argmax(axis=1)
122    out = dict(
123        sum_p=sum_p,
124        pick=pick,
125        correct=pick == true_best,
126        pick_gap=V * (best - P[lane, pick]),
127        best_share=n[lane, true_best] / n.sum(axis=1),
128        marks=marks,
129        curve=curve,
130    )
131    if trace:
132        out['trace'] = log
133    return out
134
135
136def run_group(job):
137    """One method and one uniform total, with every parameter value as its own lanes.
138
139    Process-pool entry point. All parameter values share the same worlds and the
140    same uniform-phase data, so differences between them come from the method.
141    """
142    P, pulls, signups = job['worlds'], job['pulls'], job['signups']
143    reps, params = len(P), list(job['params'])
144    seed, stream, per_arm = job['seed'], job['stream'], job['per_arm']
145
146    # Same seed for UCB and e-greedy, so both see the same uniform-phase data.
147    n, s, uniform_p, added = top_up(P, pulls, signups, per_arm,
148                                    np.random.default_rng([seed, stream, 1, per_arm]))
149    start = int(np.sum(pulls)) + added
150    horizon = max(start, job['horizon'])
151    rng = np.random.default_rng([seed, stream, 2, job['method_id'], per_arm])
152    tile = len(params)
153    res = run_policy(job['kind'], np.repeat(params, reps), np.tile(P, (tile, 1)),
154                     np.tile(n, (tile, 1)), np.tile(s, (tile, 1)), start, horizon, rng,
155                     prior=job.get('prior', (1.0, 1.0)))
156
157    best = P.max(axis=1)
158    uniform_regret = V * (best * added - uniform_p)
159    simulated = horizon - int(np.sum(pulls))
160    rows = []
161    for j, value in enumerate(params):
162        lanes = slice(j * reps, (j + 1) * reps)
163        sum_p = uniform_p + res['sum_p'][lanes]
164        rows.append(dict(
165            kind=job['kind'], param=value, per_arm=per_arm,
166            uniform_pulls=added, method_pulls=horizon - start,
167            expected_signups=V * sum_p,
168            regret=V * (best * simulated - sum_p),
169            uniform_regret=uniform_regret,
170            correct=res['correct'][lanes],
171            pick_gap=res['pick_gap'][lanes],
172            best_share=res['best_share'][lanes],
173            marks=res['marks'],
174            curve=res['curve'][:, lanes].mean(axis=1) + uniform_regret.mean(),
175        ))
176    return rows
phase2/main.pyStep 2 runner and validation · 425 lines
  1"""Phase 2: simulate every combination on conversion rates drawn from the pilot's Beta posteriors.
  2
  3Offline only. Reads phase 1's database read-only, makes no pulls, writes CSVs to results/.
  4
  5    python main.py            Run the combinations, compare them, then validate the leaders
  6    python main.py check      Check the simulator against hand calculations and program/bandit
  7    python main.py --reps 20 --total-pulls 50000     Quick trial with smaller settings
  8"""
  9import argparse
 10import csv
 11import json
 12import math
 13import os
 14import sqlite3
 15import sys
 16import time
 17from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
 18from contextlib import closing
 19from datetime import datetime
 20from pathlib import Path
 21
 22import numpy as np
 23
 24import config
 25import simulate as sim
 26from simulate import K, V
 27
 28HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 29NAMES = {'ucb': 'UCB', 'eps': 'e-greedy', 'ts': 'Thompson'}
 30METHOD_ID = {'ucb': 1, 'eps': 2, 'ts': 3}
 31MAIN_STREAM, VALIDATE_STREAM = 1, 2
 32
 33
 34def label(kind, param, per_arm):
 35    if kind == 'ts':
 36        return 'Thompson, {}/arm'.format(per_arm)
 37    value = 'x{:g}'.format(param) if kind == 'ucb' else '{:g}'.format(param)
 38    return '{} {}, {}/arm'.format(NAMES[kind], value, per_arm)
 39
 40
 41def resolve(value):
 42    path = Path(value).expanduser()
 43    return (path if path.is_absolute() else HERE / path).resolve()
 44
 45
 46# ------------------------------------------------------------------ inputs
 47def validate_settings(reps, total_pulls):
 48    def fail(message):
 49        raise SystemExit('Settings problem: {} Fix config.py, then run again.'.format(message))
 50
 51    if not config.UNIFORM_TOTALS or any(type(n) is not int or not 1 <= n <= 10_000
 52                                        for n in config.UNIFORM_TOTALS):
 53        fail('UNIFORM_TOTALS must be whole numbers from 1 to 10000.')
 54    if not config.UCB_MULTIPLIERS or any(not 0 < m <= 100 for m in config.UCB_MULTIPLIERS):
 55        fail('UCB_MULTIPLIERS must be above 0.')
 56    if not config.EPSILONS or any(not 0 < e <= 1 for e in config.EPSILONS):
 57        fail('EPSILONS must be above 0 and at most 1.')
 58    if type(config.THOMPSON) is not bool:
 59        fail('THOMPSON must be True or False.')
 60    if config.PRIOR_A <= 0 or config.PRIOR_B <= 0:
 61        fail('PRIOR_A and PRIOR_B must be above 0.')
 62    if type(reps) is not int or reps < 2 or type(config.VALIDATE_REPS) is not int or config.VALIDATE_REPS < 2:
 63        fail('REPS and VALIDATE_REPS must be whole numbers, at least 2.')
 64    if type(total_pulls) is not int or not 0 < total_pulls <= 1_000_000:
 65        fail('TOTAL_PULLS must be a whole number up to 1,000,000.')
 66
 67
 68def load_history(db_path):
 69    """Pulls and sign-ups per arm from phase 1's database, opened read-only."""
 70    if not db_path.exists():
 71        raise SystemExit('No database at {}. Run phase 1 first, or fix DB_PATH.'.format(db_path))
 72    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path.as_uri() + '?mode=ro', uri=True)) as db:
 73        rows = db.execute('SELECT arm, reward FROM results ORDER BY pull').fetchall()
 74        pending = db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pending').fetchone()[0]
 75    pulls, signups = np.zeros(K, int), np.zeros(K, int)
 76    for arm, reward in rows:
 77        pulls[arm] += 1
 78        signups[arm] += reward
 79    return pulls, signups, pending
 80
 81
 82def prob_best(a, b, draws=200_000, seed=0):
 83    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
 84    wins = np.zeros(K)
 85    for _ in range(draws // 20_000):
 86        wins += np.bincount(rng.beta(a, b, size=(20_000, K)).argmax(axis=1), minlength=K)
 87    return wins / wins.sum()
 88
 89
 90def print_posterior(pulls, signups, a, b):
 91    best = prob_best(a, b)
 92    lo, hi = beta_interval(a, b)
 93    rows = []
 94    print('\nStep 2: Beta posterior for each arm, Beta({:g} + sign-ups, {:g} + non-sign-ups)'.format(
 95        config.PRIOR_A, config.PRIOR_B))
 96    print('{:>3} {:>5} {:>8} {:>7} {:>16} {:>16} {:>7}'.format(
 97        'Arm', 'Pulls', 'Sign-ups', 'Rate', 'Beta(a, b)', '95% interval', 'P(best)'))
 98    for arm in range(K):
 99        rate = signups[arm] / (V * pulls[arm]) if pulls[arm] else float('nan')
100        print('{:>3} {:>5} {:>8} {:>7.2%} {:>16} {:>16} {:>7.1%}'.format(
101            arm, pulls[arm], signups[arm], rate, '({:g}, {:g})'.format(a[arm], b[arm]),
102            '{:.1%}-{:.1%}'.format(lo[arm], hi[arm]), best[arm]))
103        rows.append(dict(arm=arm, pulls=pulls[arm], signups=signups[arm], rate=rate, beta_a=a[arm],
104                         beta_b=b[arm], posterior_mean=a[arm] / (a[arm] + b[arm]),
105                         ci95_low=lo[arm], ci95_high=hi[arm], prob_best=best[arm]))
106    return rows
107
108
109def beta_interval(a, b, draws=200_000, seed=1):
110    sample = np.random.default_rng(seed).beta(a, b, size=(draws, K))
111    return np.percentile(sample, 2.5, axis=0), np.percentile(sample, 97.5, axis=0)
112
113
114# ------------------------------------------------------------- simulation
115def make_jobs(combos, worlds, pulls, signups, stream, total_pulls):
116    """Group combinations by method and uniform total; each group is one process."""
117    groups = {}
118    for kind, param, per_arm in combos:
119        groups.setdefault((kind, per_arm), []).append(param)
120    return [dict(kind=kind, params=params, per_arm=per_arm, worlds=worlds, pulls=pulls,
121                 signups=signups, seed=config.SEED, stream=stream, method_id=METHOD_ID[kind],
122                 horizon=total_pulls, prior=(config.PRIOR_A, config.PRIOR_B))
123            for (kind, per_arm), params in groups.items()]
124
125
126def run_jobs(jobs, workers):
127    rows, started = [], time.time()
128    workers = min(len(jobs), workers or max(1, (os.cpu_count() or 2) - 1))
129    print('Running {} groups on {} processes.'.format(len(jobs), workers), flush=True)
130    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
131        futures = {pool.submit(sim.run_group, job): job for job in jobs}
132        for done, future in enumerate(as_completed(futures), 1):
133            job = futures[future]
134            rows.extend(future.result())
135            print('  [{}/{}] {:5.0f}s  {}, {}/arm, {} values'.format(
136                done, len(jobs), time.time() - started, NAMES[job['kind']], job['per_arm'],
137                len(job['params'])), flush=True)
138    return sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (r['kind'], r['per_arm'], r['param']))
139
140
141def summarize(rows, real_signups):
142    """One line per combination, ranked by sign-ups lost against always pulling the true best arm."""
143    leader = min(rows, key=lambda r: r['regret'].mean())
144    table = []
145    for r in rows:
146        reps = len(r['regret'])
147        diff = r['regret'] - leader['regret']  # Same worlds, so the difference is paired
148        table.append(dict(
149            combination=label(r['kind'], r['param'], r['per_arm']),
150            method=NAMES[r['kind']], param=r['param'], per_arm=r['per_arm'],
151            total_signups=real_signups + r['expected_signups'].mean(),
152            regret=r['regret'].mean(), regret_se=r['regret'].std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(reps),
153            regret_p95=np.percentile(r['regret'], 95),
154            uniform_regret=r['uniform_regret'].mean(),
155            vs_leader=diff.mean(), vs_leader_se=diff.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(reps),
156            picks_best=r['correct'].mean(), best_share=r['best_share'].mean()))
157    table.sort(key=lambda row: row['regret'])
158    for rank, row in enumerate(table, 1):
159        row['rank'] = rank
160        row['tied_with_leader'] = rank == 1 or row['vs_leader'] <= 2 * row['vs_leader_se']
161    return table
162
163
164def print_table(table):
165    print('{:>4}  {:<24} {:>14} {:>18} {:>20} {:>6} {:>6}'.format(
166        'Rank', 'Combination', 'Total sign-ups', 'Lost vs best arm', 'Behind leader', 'Picks', 'Best'))
167    print('{:>4}  {:<24} {:>14} {:>18} {:>20} {:>6} {:>6}'.format(
168        '', '', '(expected)', '(+/- 2 SE)', '(+/- 2 SE)', 'best', 'share'))
169    for row in table:
170        behind = '-' if row['rank'] == 1 else '{:,.0f} +/- {:,.0f}{}'.format(
171            row['vs_leader'], 2 * row['vs_leader_se'], ' *' if row['tied_with_leader'] else '')
172        print('{:>4}  {:<24} {:>14,.0f} {:>18} {:>20} {:>6.0%} {:>6.1%}'.format(
173            row['rank'], row['combination'], row['total_signups'],
174            '{:,.0f} +/- {:,.0f}'.format(row['regret'], 2 * row['regret_se']), behind,
175            row['picks_best'], row['best_share']))
176    print('* Within 2 standard errors of the leader: these worlds can\'t separate them.')
177
178
179def phase3_note(row, pulls):
180    print('\nIn phase 3, the leading combination would mean:')
181    if row['per_arm'] > pulls.min():
182        print('  1. Uniform pulls up to {} per arm: phase 1 with PULLS_PER_ARM = {}.'.format(
183            row['per_arm'], row['per_arm']))
184    else:
185        print('  1. No more uniform pulls: start the method from the pilot data.')
186    if row['method'] == 'UCB':
187        print('  2. UCB with bonus x{:g}: program/bandit UCBModel(exploration={:g}), '
188              'because exploration = 2 x multiplier^2.'.format(row['param'], 2 * row['param'] ** 2))
189    elif row['method'] == 'Thompson':
190        print('  2. Thompson Sampling: before each pull, draw a rate from every arm\'s Beta(1 + sign-ups, '
191              '1 + non-sign-ups) and pull the highest draw. program/bandit has no Thompson model yet.')
192    else:
193        print('  2. e-greedy with e = {:g}: with that chance pull a random arm (any of 24), otherwise the '
194              'arm with the highest mean, ties to the lowest arm. program/bandit has no e-greedy model '
195              'yet.'.format(row['param']))
196
197
198# ---------------------------------------------------------------- outputs
199def write_csv(path, rows, fields=None):
200    with open(path, 'w', newline='') as handle:
201        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fields or list(rows[0]))
202        writer.writeheader()
203        for row in rows:
204            writer.writerow({k: ('{:.10g}'.format(v) if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)) else v)
205                             for k, v in row.items() if k in writer.fieldnames})
206
207
208def run_rows(stage, rows):
209    out = []
210    for r in rows:
211        for rep in range(len(r['regret'])):
212            out.append(dict(stage=stage, combination=label(r['kind'], r['param'], r['per_arm']),
213                            method=NAMES[r['kind']], param=r['param'], per_arm=r['per_arm'], world=rep,
214                            expected_signups=r['expected_signups'][rep], regret=r['regret'][rep],
215                            uniform_regret=r['uniform_regret'][rep], picks_best=int(r['correct'][rep]),
216                            pick_gap=r['pick_gap'][rep], best_share=r['best_share'][rep]))
217    return out
218
219
220def curve_rows(stage, rows):
221    return [dict(stage=stage, combination=label(r['kind'], r['param'], r['per_arm']), pull=int(t),
222                 mean_regret=value)
223            for r in rows for t, value in zip(r['marks'], r['curve'])]
224
225
226# -------------------------------------------------------------------- run
227def run(reps, total_pulls):
228    validate_settings(reps, total_pulls)
229    db_path, out_dir = resolve(config.DB_PATH), resolve(config.RESULTS_DIR)
230    pulls, signups, pending = load_history(db_path)
231    used, real_signups = int(pulls.sum()), int(signups.sum())
232    print('Phase 2 (offline, no pulls). Database: {}'.format(db_path))
233    print('Step 1: {} real pulls, {} sign-ups ({:.2%}).'.format(
234        used, real_signups, real_signups / (V * used) if used else 0))
235    if pending:
236        print('  Note: a request is pending in the database, so phase 1 may still be running.')
237    if pulls.min() != pulls.max():
238        print('  Warning: arms have {} to {} pulls. The pilot looks unfinished; finish it first '
239              'unless that is deliberate.'.format(pulls.min(), pulls.max()))
240    if total_pulls <= used + int(np.maximum(0, max(config.UNIFORM_TOTALS) - pulls).sum()):
241        raise SystemExit('TOTAL_PULLS leaves no pulls for the methods after the uniform phase.')
242    skipped = [n for n in config.UNIFORM_TOTALS if n < pulls.max()]
243    if skipped:
244        print('  Note: uniform totals {} are below pulls already made; those mean no extra '
245              'uniform pulls.'.format(skipped))
246
247    a, b = sim.posterior(pulls, signups, (config.PRIOR_A, config.PRIOR_B))
248    posterior_rows = print_posterior(pulls, signups, a, b)
249
250    combos = ([('ucb', m, n) for n in config.UNIFORM_TOTALS for m in config.UCB_MULTIPLIERS]
251              + [('eps', e, n) for n in config.UNIFORM_TOTALS for e in config.EPSILONS]
252              + ([('ts', 0.0, n) for n in config.UNIFORM_TOTALS] if config.THOMPSON else []))
253    print('\nStep 3: {} combinations x {} worlds, {:,} pulls each ({:,} real + {:,} simulated).'.format(
254        len(combos), reps, total_pulls, used, total_pulls - used))
255    worlds = sim.draw_worlds(a, b, reps, config.SEED, MAIN_STREAM)
256    oracle = real_signups + V * worlds.max(axis=1).mean() * (total_pulls - used)
257    started = time.time()
258    rows = run_jobs(make_jobs(combos, worlds, pulls, signups, MAIN_STREAM, total_pulls), config.WORKERS)
259
260    print('\nStep 4a: compare. "Lost vs best arm" counts expected sign-ups lost on the simulated pulls, '
261          'compared with\nalways pulling each world\'s true best arm (which would total about {:,.0f} '
262          'sign-ups, real pulls included).\n'.format(oracle))
263    table = summarize(rows, real_signups)
264    print_table(table)
265
266    # The leaders, plus the best of any method not among them, so every method is checked.
267    top = table[:config.VALIDATE_TOP]
268    for method in NAMES.values():
269        if not any(r['method'] == method for r in top):
270            top += [r for r in table if r['method'] == method][:1]
271    print('\nStep 4b: validate. The top {} and the best of each method ({} in all) rerun on {} fresh '
272          'worlds,\nbecause the best of {} on the same worlds looks better than it is.'.format(
273              config.VALIDATE_TOP, len(top), config.VALIDATE_REPS, len(table)))
274    fresh = sim.draw_worlds(a, b, config.VALIDATE_REPS, config.SEED, VALIDATE_STREAM)
275    kinds = {v: k for k, v in NAMES.items()}
276    val_rows = run_jobs(make_jobs([(kinds[r['method']], r['param'], r['per_arm']) for r in top],
277                                  fresh, pulls, signups, VALIDATE_STREAM, total_pulls), config.WORKERS)
278    validation = summarize(val_rows, real_signups)
279    print_table(validation)
280
281    leader = table[0]['combination']
282    held = next(r for r in validation if r['combination'] == leader)
283    if held['rank'] == 1:
284        verdict = 'CONFIRMED: {} leads on fresh worlds too.'.format(leader)
285    elif held['tied_with_leader']:
286        verdict = ('TIED: {} is within 2 SE of {} on fresh worlds. Either is defensible; the gap is '
287                   'too small to measure.'.format(leader, validation[0]['combination']))
288    else:
289        verdict = ('NOT CONFIRMED: {} falls clearly behind {} on fresh worlds. Increase REPS and '
290                   'rerun before choosing.'.format(leader, validation[0]['combination']))
291    print('\n' + verdict)
292    chosen = table[0]
293    grid = {'UCB': config.UCB_MULTIPLIERS, 'e-greedy': config.EPSILONS}.get(chosen['method'])
294    if grid and chosen['param'] in (min(grid), max(grid)):
295        print('Note: {:g} is at the edge of the values tried, so a value beyond it might do even better. '
296              'Consider adding one to config.py and rerunning.'.format(chosen['param']))
297    phase3_note(validation[0] if held['rank'] != 1 and not held['tied_with_leader'] else table[0], pulls)
298
299    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
300    write_csv(out_dir / 'posterior.csv', posterior_rows)
301    write_csv(out_dir / 'summary.csv', table)
302    write_csv(out_dir / 'validation.csv', validation)
303    write_csv(out_dir / 'runs.csv', run_rows('compare', rows) + run_rows('validate', val_rows))
304    write_csv(out_dir / 'curves.csv', curve_rows('compare', rows) + curve_rows('validate', val_rows))
305    with open(out_dir / 'run_info.json', 'w') as handle:
306        json.dump(dict(finished=datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds'), database=str(db_path),
307                       real_pulls=used, real_signups=real_signups, pending_request=bool(pending),
308                       total_pulls=total_pulls, reps=reps, validate_reps=config.VALIDATE_REPS,
309                       validate_top=config.VALIDATE_TOP, seed=config.SEED,
310                       prior=[config.PRIOR_A, config.PRIOR_B], uniform_totals=config.UNIFORM_TOTALS,
311                       ucb_multipliers=config.UCB_MULTIPLIERS, epsilons=config.EPSILONS,
312                       oracle_signups=oracle, verdict=verdict, seconds=round(time.time() - started)),
313                  handle, indent=2)
314    print('\nFinished in {:.0f} minutes. Results: {}'.format((time.time() - started) / 60, out_dir))
315
316
317# ----------------------------------------------------------------- checks
318def check():
319    """Compare the simulator with hand calculations and with program/bandit's UCBModel."""
320    ok = True
321
322    def report(name, passed, detail):
323        nonlocal ok
324        ok &= passed
325        print('{}  {}: {}'.format('PASS' if passed else 'FAIL', name, detail))
326
327    # 1. UCB chooses exactly what program/bandit's UCBModel would, given the same rewards.
328    sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent / 'program'))
329    from bandit import UCBModel
330
331    rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
332    P = np.array([rng.uniform(.10, .20, K)])
333    pulls = np.full(K, 10)
334    history, signups, net = [], np.zeros(K, int), 0
335    for i in range(10 * K):
336        arm = i % K
337        reward = int(rng.binomial(V, P[0, arm]))
338        net += reward
339        signups[arm] += reward
340        history.append({'Arm': str(arm), 'Reward': reward, 'NetReward': net, 'Pull': i})
341    for multiplier in (0.05, 0.25, 1.0):
342        n0, s0 = np.tile(pulls.astype(float), (1, 1)), signups[None, :].astype(float)
343        res = sim.run_policy('ucb', [multiplier], P, n0, s0, 10 * K, 10 * K + 3000,
344                             np.random.default_rng(8), trace=True)
345        model = UCBModel(exploration=2 * multiplier ** 2).fit(history)
346        total, mismatches = net, 0
347        for step, (arm, reward) in enumerate(zip(res['trace']['arms'], res['trace']['rewards'])):
348            mismatches += model.select_arm() != arm
349            total += reward
350            model.update({'Arm': str(arm), 'Reward': reward, 'NetReward': total, 'Pull': 10 * K + step})
351        report('UCB x{:g} matches UCBModel(exploration={:g})'.format(multiplier, 2 * multiplier ** 2),
352               mismatches == 0, '{} of 3000 choices differ'.format(mismatches))
353
354    # 2. e = 1 pulls uniformly at random: expected loss = pulls x 100 x mean gap to the best arm.
355    lanes, steps = 400, 5000
356    P = np.random.default_rng(9).uniform(.10, .20, (lanes, K))
357    n0, s0 = np.full((lanes, K), 10.0), np.round(P * V * 10)
358    res = sim.run_policy('eps', np.ones(lanes), P, n0, s0, 240, 240 + steps, np.random.default_rng(10))
359    simulated = V * (P.max(axis=1) * steps - res['sum_p'])
360    formula = V * steps * (P.max(axis=1, keepdims=True) - P).mean(axis=1)
361    diff = simulated - formula
362    se = diff.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(lanes)
363    report('e = 1 loss matches the formula', abs(diff.mean()) < 4 * se,
364           'simulated {:,.0f}, formula {:,.0f} (SE {:,.0f})'.format(simulated.mean(), formula.mean(), se))
365
366    # 3. e = 0.1 with an obvious leader: loss = pulls x e x 23/24 x 100 x gap.
367    P = np.full((lanes, K), .10)
368    P[:, 3] = .30
369    n0, s0 = np.full((lanes, K), 1000.0), P * V * 1000
370    res = sim.run_policy('eps', np.full(lanes, .1), P, n0, s0, 24_000, 24_000 + steps,
371                         np.random.default_rng(11))
372    simulated = V * (.30 * steps - res['sum_p'])
373    expected = steps * .1 * 23 / 24 * V * .20
374    se = simulated.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(lanes)
375    report('e = 0.1 loss matches the formula', abs(simulated.mean() - expected) < 4 * se,
376           'simulated {:,.0f}, formula {:,.0f} (SE {:,.0f})'.format(simulated.mean(), expected, se))
377
378    # 4. Thompson Sampling matches a plain one-pull-at-a-time version fed the same random numbers.
379    P = np.random.default_rng(13).uniform(.10, .20, (1, K))
380    n0, s0 = np.full((1, K), 10.0), np.round(P * V * 10)
381    res = sim.run_policy('ts', [0.0], P, n0, s0, 240, 240 + 3000, np.random.default_rng(14), trace=True)
382    rng, n, s, mismatches = np.random.default_rng(14), n0.copy(), s0.copy(), 0
383    for arm_sim, reward_sim in zip(res['trace']['arms'], res['trace']['rewards']):
384        arm = int(rng.beta(1 + s, 1 + V * n - s).argmax())
385        reward = int(rng.binomial(V, P[:, arm])[0])
386        mismatches += arm != arm_sim or reward != reward_sim
387        n[0, arm] += 1
388        s[0, arm] += reward
389    report('Thompson matches a plain loop', mismatches == 0, '{} of 3000 pulls differ'.format(mismatches))
390
391    # 5. Thompson concentrates on an obvious winner (30% against 10%).
392    P = np.full((lanes, K), .10)
393    P[:, 3] = .30
394    n0, s0 = np.full((lanes, K), 10.0), P * V * 10
395    res = sim.run_policy('ts', np.zeros(lanes), P, n0, s0, 240, 240 + 2000, np.random.default_rng(15))
396    share = (res['best_share'] * 2240 - 10) / 2000  # Share of the 2,000 new pulls
397    report('Thompson finds an obvious winner', share.mean() > .95,
398           '{:.1%} of new pulls went to the best arm'.format(share.mean()))
399
400    # 6. The uniform phase tops every arm up to exactly the target, and no further.
401    P = np.full((3, K), .15)
402    start = np.arange(K) * 2  # Some arms start above the target
403    n, s, uniform_p, added = sim.top_up(P, start, start * 15, 25, np.random.default_rng(12))
404    target = np.maximum(start, 25)
405    report('uniform phase tops up to the target', bool((n == target).all()) and added == int((target - start).sum()),
406           '{} pulls added, arms now have {} to {} pulls'.format(added, int(n.min()), int(n.max())))
407
408    # 7. The Beta posterior uses sign-ups and non-sign-ups.
409    a, b = sim.posterior([10, 10], [150, 0])
410    report('Beta posterior', list(a) == [151, 1] and list(b) == [851, 1001],
411           'arm with 150/1000 -> Beta(151, 851); arm with 0/1000 -> Beta(1, 1001)')
412
413    print('\nAll checks passed.' if ok else '\nSome checks FAILED. Don\'t trust the simulation until fixed.')
414    return 0 if ok else 1
415
416
417if __name__ == '__main__':
418    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
419    parser.add_argument('command', nargs='?', default='run', choices=['run', 'check'])
420    parser.add_argument('--reps', type=int, default=config.REPS, help='override REPS')
421    parser.add_argument('--total-pulls', type=int, default=config.TOTAL_PULLS, help='override TOTAL_PULLS')
422    args = parser.parse_args()
423    if args.command == 'check':
424        sys.exit(check())
425    run(args.reps, args.total_pulls)
phase2/config.pyStep 2 settings · 28 lines
 1"""Phase 2 settings. Edit this file, then run `python main.py`.
 2
 3Phase 2 is offline: it makes no pulls and opens the database read-only.
 4"""
 5
 6# Data: the pilot pulls saved by phase 1. Relative paths are anchored to this folder.
 7DB_PATH = "../program/data/history.sqlite3"
 8RESULTS_DIR = "results"         # CSVs are written here; each run overwrites them
 9
10# Beta prior for each arm's conversion rate: Beta(1, 1) is uniform on 0-100%.
11# Posterior = Beta(PRIOR_A + sign-ups, PRIOR_B + non-sign-ups).
12PRIOR_A = 1.0
13PRIOR_B = 1.0
14
15# The combinations: each uniform total x (every UCB multiplier, every epsilon, and Thompson Sampling).
16# The original plan's 40 used multipliers 0.05-1; 0.005-0.02 were added after 0.05 won at the edge.
17UNIFORM_TOTALS = [10, 25, 50, 100]          # Pulls per arm, real pilot included, before the method takes over
18UCB_MULTIPLIERS = [0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1]  # Bonus = multiplier x sqrt(2 ln t / n)
19EPSILONS = [0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2]    # Chance of pulling a random arm instead of the leader
20THOMPSON = True                 # Also simulate Thompson Sampling (no parameter to tune) at each uniform total
21
22# Simulation size
23TOTAL_PULLS = 1_000_000         # Whole budget, real pulls included. Lower it if time runs short
24REPS = 200                      # Simulated worlds, shared by all 40 combinations
25VALIDATE_TOP = 5                # This many leading combinations are rerun on fresh worlds
26VALIDATE_REPS = 200             # Worlds in that rerun
27SEED = 5101                     # Same seed and settings give the same results
28WORKERS = None                  # Parallel processes; None means CPU count minus 1

  1"""Continuous UCB runner. Offline by default; Ctrl-C requests a durable stop."""
  2
  3import argparse
  4import json
  5import math
  6import os
  7import sqlite3
  8import sys
  9from contextlib import closing
 10from datetime import timedelta, timezone
 11from getpass import getpass

 14import config

 16HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
 17PROGRAM = HERE.parent / 'program'
 18if str(PROGRAM) not in sys.path:
 19    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROGRAM))

 21from bandit import UCBModel, TuningConfig, run_experiment

 23from bandit.common import MAX_PULLS, integer

 29class ConfigError(ValueError):
 30    pass

 33def exploration():
 34    return round(2 * config.UCB_MULTIPLIER ** 2, 12)

 37def resolve_path(value):
 38    path = Path(value).expanduser()
 39    return (path if path.is_absolute() else HERE / path).resolve()

 42def validate_config():
 43    for name in ('TARGET_TOTAL_PULLS', 'MAX_PULLS_THIS_RUN'):
 44        value = getattr(config, name)
 45        if value is not None:
 46            integer(value, name, maximum=MAX_PULLS)
 47    m = config.UCB_MULTIPLIER
 48    if isinstance(m, bool) or not isinstance(m, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(m) or not 0 < m <= 1:
 49        raise ConfigError('UCB_MULTIPLIER must be in (0, 1].')
 50    if config.MAX_RETRIES is not None:
 51        integer(config.MAX_RETRIES, 'MAX_RETRIES')
 52    integer(config.PROGRESS_EVERY, 'PROGRESS_EVERY', minimum=1)
 53    for name in ('ONLINE', 'AUTO_TUNE', 'ALLOW_UNSAVED_SERVER_PULLS'):
 54        if type(getattr(config, name)) is not bool:
 55            raise ConfigError(name+' must be True or False.')
 56    if not isinstance(config.GROUP_USERNAME, str):
 57        raise ConfigError('GROUP_USERNAME must be text.')
 58    validate_settings(config.REQUEST_INTERVAL, config.REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

 61def tuning_config(enabled):
 62    if not enabled:
 63        return None
 64    return TuningConfig(interval=config.TUNE_EVERY, candidates=config.TUNE_CANDIDATES,
 65                        train_worlds=config.TUNE_TRAIN_WORLDS,
 66                        validation_worlds=config.TUNE_VALIDATION_WORLDS,
 67                        max_seconds=config.TUNE_MAX_SECONDS, cvar_level=config.TUNE_CVAR_LEVEL,
 68                        stage_loss_allowance=config.TUNE_STAGE_LOSS_ALLOWANCE,
 69                        tail_loss_allowance=config.TUNE_TAIL_LOSS_ALLOWANCE)

 72def saved_state(path):
 73    if not path.is_file():
 74        return 0, None, 0
 75    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path.as_uri()+'?mode=ro', uri=True)) as db:
 76        db.execute('BEGIN')
 77        count, used = db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*),COALESCE(MAX(pull)+1,0) FROM results').fetchone()
 78        row = db.execute('SELECT payload FROM pending WHERE singleton=1').fetchone()
 79        return count, json.loads(row[0]) if row else None, used

 82def print_progress(row):
 83    seconds = row['elapsed_seconds']
 84    speed = row['completed_pulls']/seconds if seconds else 0
 85    print('Saved {:,} | this run {:,} | sign-ups {:,} | {:.2f} pulls/s | exploration {:g}'.format(
 86        row['history_pulls'], row['completed_pulls'], row['history_signups'], speed,
 87        row['parameters']['exploration']), flush=True)

 90def report(summary):
 91    print('\nArm    Pulls    Sign-ups     Rate')
 92    for row in sorted(summary['arms'], key=lambda r: -(r['conversion_rate'] or 0)):
 93        rate = '{:.3%}'.format(row['conversion_rate']) if row['conversion_rate'] is not None else '-'
 94        print('{:3} {:8,} {:11,} {:>9}'.format(row['arm'], row['pulls'], row['signups'], rate))
 95    print('\nSaved: {:,}. Stop reason: {}. Next/recovery arm: {}.'.format(
 96        summary['history_pulls'], summary['stop_reason'], summary['next_arm']))
 97    state = summary['tuning_state']
 98    if state:
 99        print('Last tuning: {}; selected x{:g}; next due at {:,} saved pulls.'.format(
100            state['reason'], state['selected_multiplier'], state['next_at']))

103def main(argv=None):
104    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
105    parser.add_argument('--online', action='store_true', default=None)
106    parser.add_argument('--limit', type=int, help='Maximum additional pulls; omitted uses config (None = remaining)')
107    parser.add_argument('--target-total', type=int, help='Optional absolute group pull cap')
108    group = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
109    group.add_argument('--auto-tune', dest='auto_tune', action='store_true', default=None)
110    group.add_argument('--no-auto-tune', dest='auto_tune', action='store_false')
111    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
112    password, db_path = None, None
113    try:
114        validate_config()
115        online = config.ONLINE if args.online is None else args.online
116        budget = config.MAX_PULLS_THIS_RUN if args.limit is None else args.limit
117        target = config.TARGET_TOTAL_PULLS if args.target_total is None else args.target_total
118        if budget is not None:
119            integer(budget, 'limit', maximum=MAX_PULLS)
120        if target is not None:
121            integer(target, 'target_total', maximum=MAX_PULLS)
122        tune = tuning_config(config.AUTO_TUNE if args.auto_tune is None else args.auto_tune)
123        db_path = resolve_path(config.DB_PATH)
124        count, pending, used = saved_state(db_path)
125        if target is not None and not pending:
126            budget = min(budget if budget is not None else MAX_PULLS, max(0, target-used))
127        print('Mode: {}. Saved: {:,}. Additional cap: {}. Tuning: {}.'.format(
128            'ONLINE' if online else 'OFFLINE', count,
129            'all remaining' if budget is None else '{:,}'.format(budget), bool(tune)), flush=True)
130        username = None
131        if online and budget != 0:
132            username = config.GROUP_USERNAME.strip() or input('Group username: ').strip()
133            if not username:
134                raise ConfigError('A group username is required.')
135            password = os.environ.get('GP3_PASSWORD') or getpass('Group password: ')
136        summary = run_experiment(
137            UCBModel(exploration()), budget, online=online, db_path=db_path,
138            username=username, password=password, interval=config.REQUEST_INTERVAL,
139            timeout=config.REQUEST_TIMEOUT, max_retries=config.MAX_RETRIES,
140            log_path=resolve_path(config.LOG_PATH) if config.LOG_PATH is not None else None,
141            target_total=target, tuning=tune, strict_history=not config.ALLOW_UNSAVED_SERVER_PULLS,
142            progress=print_progress, progress_every=config.PROGRESS_EVERY)
143        report(summary)
144        return 0
145    except KeyboardInterrupt:
146        print('Forced interruption. Saved results and pending request are retained.', file=sys.stderr)
147        return 130
148    except Exception as error:
149        # Never echo arbitrary remote error messages or credential-bearing tracebacks.
150        print('Run stopped ({}). Check settings, saved history and the local log. '
151              'Resolve any pending request before continuing.'.format(type(error).__name__), file=sys.stderr)
152        return 1
153    finally:
154        password = None
155
156
157if __name__ == '__main__':
158    raise SystemExit(main())

program/bandit/models.pyUniform and UCB models · 100 lines
  1"""Incremental bandit policies trained from saved real batch outcomes."""
  2
  3import math
  4
  5from .common import ARMS, VISITORS_PER_PULL, integer, normalize_result
  6
  7
  8class UniformModel:
  9    """Balance historical pull counts, breaking ties by the lowest arm ID."""
 10
 11    name = "uniform"
 12
 13    def __init__(self):
 14        self.counts = [0] * ARMS
 15        self.signups = [0] * ARMS
 16        self.total_pulls = 0
 17
 18    @property
 19    def parameters(self):
 20        return {}
 21
 22    def fit(self, results):
 23        self.counts = [0] * ARMS
 24        self.signups = [0] * ARMS
 25        self.total_pulls = 0
 26        for result in results:
 27            self.update(result)
 28        return self
 29
 30    def fit_aggregates(self, rows):
 31        """Load sufficient statistics without allocating historical response objects."""
 32        self.counts = [0] * ARMS
 33        self.signups = [0] * ARMS
 34        for row in rows:
 35            arm = integer(row['arm'], 'arm', maximum=ARMS - 1)
 36            count = integer(row['pulls'], 'pulls')
 37            signups = integer(row['signups'], 'signups', maximum=VISITORS_PER_PULL * count)
 38            self.counts[arm] += count
 39            self.signups[arm] += signups
 40        self.total_pulls = sum(self.counts)
 41        return self
 42
 43    def update(self, result):
 44        row = normalize_result(result)
 45        arm = int(row["Arm"])
 46        self.counts[arm] += 1
 47        self.signups[arm] += row["Reward"]
 48        self.total_pulls += 1
 49
 50    def select_arm(self):
 51        return min(range(ARMS), key=lambda arm: (self.counts[arm], arm))
 52
 53    def summary(self):
 54        return [{"arm": arm, "pulls": self.counts[arm], "signups": self.signups[arm],
 55                 "conversion_rate": (self.signups[arm] / (VISITORS_PER_PULL * self.counts[arm])
 56                                     if self.counts[arm] else None)}
 57                for arm in range(ARMS)]
 58
 59
 60class UCBModel(UniformModel):
 61    """Batch-reward UCB; each pull's bounded reward is Reward / 100."""
 62
 63    name = "ucb"
 64
 65    def __init__(self, exploration=2.0):
 66        if (isinstance(exploration, bool) or not isinstance(exploration, (int, float))
 67                or not math.isfinite(exploration) or exploration <= 0):
 68            raise ValueError("exploration must be finite and positive")
 69        super().__init__()
 70        self.exploration = float(exploration)
 71
 72    @property
 73    def parameters(self):
 74        return {"exploration": self.exploration}
 75
 76    def _score(self, arm):
 77        count = self.counts[arm]
 78        if not count:
 79            return float("inf")
 80        mean = self.signups[arm] / (VISITORS_PER_PULL * count)
 81        return mean + math.sqrt(self.exploration * math.log(self.total_pulls) / count)
 82
 83    def select_arm(self):
 84        return max(range(ARMS), key=lambda arm: (self._score(arm), -arm))
 85
 86    def summary(self):
 87        rows = super().summary()
 88        for row in rows:
 89            row["score"] = self._score(row["arm"]) if row["pulls"] else None
 90        return rows
 91
 92
 93def make_model(model):
 94    if model == "uniform":
 95        return UniformModel()
 96    if model == "ucb":
 97        return UCBModel()
 98    if isinstance(model, (UniformModel, UCBModel)):
 99        return model
100    raise ValueError("model must be 'uniform', 'ucb', or a model instance")

  1"""Local learning, durable online pulls and bounded recovery."""
  2
  3import uuid
  4import math
  5import time
  6from datetime import datetime, timezone
  7from pathlib import Path
  8
  9from server_pull import UncertainPullError
 10
 11from .audit import OnlineLog
 12from .client import PacedClient, validate_settings
 13from .control import StopController, StopRequested
 14from .common import DEADLINE, MAX_PULLS, SERVER_URL, integer, normalize_result, server_address
 15from .models import UCBModel, make_model
 16from .storage import HistoryStore, driver_lock
 17from .tuning import TuningConfig, evaluate_isolated
 18
 19DEFAULT_DB = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data" / "history.sqlite3"
 20
 21
 22class _DeadlineReached(RuntimeError):
 23    """Internal signal: a fresh request was cancelled before transmission."""
 24
 25
 26def utc_now():
 27    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 28
 29
 30def save_results(results, *, username, db_path=DEFAULT_DB, server_url=SERVER_URL):
 31    """Append actual historical responses, with deduplication and explicit provenance."""
 32    with driver_lock(db_path), HistoryStore(db_path) as store:
 33        store.bind(username, server_url)
 34        return store.import_results(results)
 35
 36
 37def _status(client, log):
 38    state = client.status()
 39    used = integer(state.get("PullsUsed"), "server PullsUsed", maximum=MAX_PULLS)
 40    total = integer(state.get("NetReward"), "server NetReward", maximum=used * 100)
 41    maximum = integer(state.get("MaxPulls"), "server MaxPulls", minimum=used, maximum=MAX_PULLS)
 42    if type(state.get("Open")) is not bool:
 43        raise ValueError("Invalid server Open flag")
 44    state = {"PullsUsed": used, "NetReward": total, "MaxPulls": maximum, "Open": state["Open"]}
 45    log.write("status", status=state)
 46    return state
 47
 48
 49def _resolve(store, client, log, max_retries, *, fresh=False, stop=None):
 50    request = store.pending
 51    attempt = 0
 52    while True:
 53        attempt += 1
 54        if stop:
 55            stop.check()
 56        log.write("pull_attempt", attempt=attempt, request=request)
 57        try:
 58            def before_send():
 59                if stop and stop.is_set():
 60                    if fresh and attempt == 1:
 61                        store._cancel_unsent(request['request_id'])
 62                    raise StopRequested()
 63                if fresh and attempt == 1 and utc_now() >= DEADLINE:
 64                    # The current call has not entered HTTP yet, so cancellation
 65                    # is safe. Previously attempted/durable recoveries stay intact.
 66                    store._cancel_unsent(request["request_id"])
 67                    log.write("pull_cancelled", request=request, reason="deadline_reached")
 68                    raise _DeadlineReached()
 69
 70            response = client.pull(request, before_send=before_send)
 71            # Treat an invalid response as uncertain; do not abandon its identity.
 72            try:
 73                row = normalize_result(response)
 74            except ValueError:
 75                raise UncertainPullError(request["request_id"], request["expected_pull"]) from None
 76            store.complete(row)
 77            log.write("pull_completed", attempt=attempt, request=request, result=row)
 78            return row
 79        except UncertainPullError:
 80            retry = max_retries is None or attempt <= max_retries
 81            log.write("pull_uncertain", attempt=attempt, request=request,
 82                      retry_scheduled=retry)
 83            if stop:
 84                stop.check()
 85            if not retry:
 86                raise
 87            client.wait_before_retry()
 88            if max_retries is None and attempt > 1:
 89                delay = min(30., 2. ** min(attempt-1, 5))
 90                if stop:
 91                    if stop.wait(delay):
 92                        raise StopRequested()
 93                else:
 94                    time.sleep(delay)
 95
 96
 97def _summary(model, store, *, online, budget, completed, reason, state=None, log_path=None):
 98    pending = store.pending
 99    return {"online": online, "model": model.name, "parameters": model.parameters,
100            "requested_budget": budget, "completed_pulls": completed,
101            "history_pulls": model.total_pulls, "history_signups": sum(model.signups),
102            "next_arm": pending["arm"] if pending else model.select_arm(),
103            "pending_request": pending, "stop_reason": reason,
104            "server_status": state, "db_path": str(store.path),
105            "log_path": str(log_path) if log_path else None, "arms": model.summary(),
106            "tuning_state": store.tuning_state()}
107
108
109def run_experiment(model="uniform", budget=None, *, online=False, db_path=DEFAULT_DB,
110                   username=None, password=None, server_url=SERVER_URL,
111                   interval=0.25, timeout=10.0, max_retries=2, log_path=None,
112                   target_total=None, tuning=None, strict_history=False,
113                   stop_event=None, handle_signals=True, progress=None, progress_every=1000):
114    """Fit saved history; optionally complete at most `budget` real pulls.
115
116    Recovery of an earlier pending request occupies one budget slot in this run.
117    Offline mode never makes requests, creates outcomes, or truncates training.
118    Exceptions stop the run; committed results and unresolved request IDs survive.
119    """
120    if budget is not None:
121        integer(budget, "budget")
122    if target_total is not None:
123        integer(target_total, 'target_total', maximum=MAX_PULLS)
124    if max_retries is not None:
125        integer(max_retries, "max_retries")
126    integer(progress_every, 'progress_every', minimum=1)
127    if any(type(x) is not bool for x in (online, strict_history, handle_signals)):
128        raise ValueError("Run switches must be booleans")
129    if tuning is not None and not isinstance(tuning, TuningConfig):
130        raise ValueError('tuning must be TuningConfig or None')
131    validate_settings(interval, timeout)
132    server_url = server_address(server_url)
133    policy = make_model(model)
134    if tuning is not None and not isinstance(policy, UCBModel):
135        raise ValueError('Automatic tuning requires UCB')
136    limit = budget if budget is not None else MAX_PULLS
137    with driver_lock(db_path), HistoryStore(db_path) as store, StopController(stop_event, handle_signals) as stop:
138        policy.fit_aggregates(store.aggregate())
139        saved_tuning = store.tuning_state()
140        if tuning is not None and saved_tuning and saved_tuning.get('config_key') == tuning.key():
141            policy.exploration = UCBModel(round(2*saved_tuning['selected_multiplier']**2, 12)).exploration
142        if not online or budget == 0:
143            return _summary(policy, store, online=online, budget=budget, completed=0,
144                            reason="offline" if not online else "zero_budget")
145        if target_total is not None:
146            pending = store.pending
147            used = (store.last_pull+1) if store.last_pull is not None else 0
148            if (pending and pending['expected_pull'] >= target_total) or (not pending and used >= target_total):
149                return _summary(policy, store, online=True, budget=budget, completed=0, reason='target_reached')
150        client = PacedClient(username, password, server_url, interval=interval, timeout=timeout)
151        store.bind(username, server_url)
152        log_path = (Path(log_path).expanduser().resolve() if log_path is not None
153                    else store.path.with_suffix(".online.jsonl"))
154        if log_path in (store.path, store.path.with_suffix(store.path.suffix + ".lock")):
155            raise ValueError("Online log cannot overwrite the database or its lock")
156        completed, state, reason = 0, None, "budget_complete"
157        started = time.monotonic()
158        def notify_progress():
159            if progress:
160                progress({'completed_pulls': completed, 'history_pulls': policy.total_pulls,
161                          'history_signups': sum(policy.signups), 'parameters': policy.parameters,
162                          'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic()-started, 'server_status': state})
163
164        def maybe_tune():
165            nonlocal saved_tuning
166            if tuning is None or not all(policy.counts):
167                return
168            if (saved_tuning and saved_tuning.get('config_key') == tuning.key()
169                    and policy.total_pulls < saved_tuning['next_at']):
170                return
171            stop.check()
172            remaining = min(state['MaxPulls'], target_total if target_total is not None else MAX_PULLS)-state['PullsUsed']
173            baseline = round(math.sqrt(policy.exploration/2), 12)
174            log.write('tuning_started', at_pull=policy.total_pulls, remaining=remaining, baseline=baseline)
175            try:
176                decision = evaluate_isolated(policy.summary(), remaining, baseline, tuning, stop)
177            except StopRequested:
178                raise
179            except Exception as error:
180                decision = {'selected_multiplier': baseline, 'reason': 'tuning_failed',
181                            'error_type': type(error).__name__}
182            stop.check()
183            selected = UCBModel(round(2*decision['selected_multiplier']**2, 12)).exploration
184            decision.update(at_pull=policy.total_pulls, next_at=policy.total_pulls+tuning.interval,
185                            config_key=tuning.key())
186            store.record_tuning(decision)
187            saved_tuning = decision
188            policy.exploration = selected
189            log.write('tuning_completed', decision=decision)
190        with OnlineLog(log_path, str(uuid.uuid4())) as log:
191            log.write("run_started", model=policy.name, parameters=policy.parameters,
192                      budget=budget, history_pulls=policy.total_pulls,
193                      interval=interval, timeout=timeout, max_retries=max_retries)
194            try:
195                stop.check()
196                if utc_now() >= DEADLINE and store.pending is None:
197                    reason = "deadline_reached"
198                else:
199                    with client:
200                        # Recovery must precede status/new-arm selection. Status may be
201                        # ahead of the pending counter after an unacknowledged success.
202                        if store.pending is not None:
203                            client.wait_before_retry()
204                            row = _resolve(store, client, log, max_retries, stop=stop)
205                            policy.update(row)
206                            completed += 1
207                        if completed < limit:
208                            stop.check()
209                            state = _status(client, log)
210                            if store.last_pull is not None and store.last_pull >= state["PullsUsed"]:
211                                raise RuntimeError("Saved history is ahead of the server; check the group and data")
212                            if strict_history and (policy.total_pulls != state['PullsUsed'] or
213                                                   sum(policy.signups) != state['NetReward']):
214                                raise RuntimeError('The server has pulls this database does not; reconcile saved history')
215                            notify_progress()
216                        while completed < limit:
217                            stop.check()
218                            if utc_now() >= DEADLINE:
219                                reason = "deadline_reached"
220                                break
221                            if not state["Open"]:
222                                reason = "server_closed"
223                                break
224                            if state["PullsUsed"] >= state["MaxPulls"]:
225                                reason = "group_budget_exhausted"
226                                break
227                            if target_total is not None and state['PullsUsed'] >= target_total:
228                                reason = 'target_reached'
229                                break
230                            maybe_tune()
231                            stop.check()
232                            if utc_now() >= DEADLINE:
233                                reason = 'deadline_reached'
234                                break
235                            request = store.prepare(arm=policy.select_arm(), expected_pull=state["PullsUsed"],
236                                                    model=policy.name, parameters=policy.parameters)
237                            log.write("pull_prepared", request=request)
238                            try:
239                                row = _resolve(store, client, log, max_retries, fresh=True, stop=stop)
240                            except _DeadlineReached:
241                                reason = "deadline_reached"
242                                break
243                            policy.update(row)
244                            completed += 1
245                            state = {**state, "PullsUsed": row["Pull"] + 1, "NetReward": row["NetReward"]}
246                            if completed % progress_every == 0:
247                                notify_progress()
248                log.write("run_finished", completed_pulls=completed, stop_reason=reason,
249                          history_pulls=policy.total_pulls)
250            except StopRequested:
251                reason = 'manual_stop'
252                log.write('run_finished', completed_pulls=completed, stop_reason=reason,
253                          history_pulls=policy.total_pulls, pending_request=store.pending)
254            except BaseException as error:
255                # Do not persist remote exception messages, headers, or credentials.
256                log.write("run_failed", error_type=type(error).__name__, completed_pulls=completed,
257                          pending_request=store.pending)
258                raise
259        notify_progress()
260        return _summary(policy, store, online=True, budget=budget, completed=completed,
261                        reason=reason, state=state, log_path=log_path)
program/bandit/storage.pySQLite history and pending requests · 198 lines
  1"""Append-only results and transactional recovery state in one local database."""
  2
  3import json
  4import sqlite3
  5import uuid
  6from contextlib import contextmanager
  7from pathlib import Path
  8
  9from .common import ARMS, MAX_PULLS, integer, normalize_result, server_address, timestamp
 10
 11
 12@contextmanager
 13def driver_lock(path):
 14    """One driver per resolved database on macOS/Linux/Windows."""
 15    try:
 16        import fcntl
 17    except ImportError:
 18        fcntl = None
 19        import msvcrt
 20
 21    path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
 22    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 23    with path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".lock").open("a+b") as handle:
 24        if fcntl is None:
 25            handle.seek(0, 2)
 26            if not handle.tell():
 27                handle.write(b'\0')
 28                handle.flush()
 29            handle.seek(0)
 30        try:
 31            if fcntl is not None:
 32                fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 33            else:
 34                msvcrt.locking(handle.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_NBLCK, 1)
 35        except OSError:
 36            raise RuntimeError("Another driver is using this database") from None
 37        try:
 38            yield
 39        finally:
 40            if fcntl is not None:
 41                fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
 42            else:
 43                handle.seek(0)
 44                msvcrt.locking(handle.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_UNLCK, 1)
 45
 46
 47class HistoryStore:
 48    def __init__(self, path):
 49        self.path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
 50        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 51        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=5)
 52        self.connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
 53        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA synchronous = FULL")
 54        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA cache_size = -4096")
 55        self.connection.execute("PRAGMA temp_store = FILE")
 56        self.connection.executescript("""
 57            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS metadata (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
 58            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS results (
 59                pull INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, arm INTEGER NOT NULL, reward INTEGER NOT NULL,
 60                net_reward INTEGER NOT NULL, saved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 61                model TEXT NOT NULL, parameters TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT);
 62            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pending (
 63                singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), payload TEXT NOT NULL);
 64            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tuning_decisions (
 65                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, at_pull INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL);
 66        """)
 67
 68    def __enter__(self):
 69        return self
 70
 71    def __exit__(self, *args):
 72        self.close()
 73
 74    def close(self):
 75        self.connection.close()
 76
 77    @property
 78    def identity(self):
 79        row = self.connection.execute("SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE key='identity'").fetchone()
 80        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else None
 81
 82    def bind(self, username, server_url):
 83        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username.strip():
 84            raise ValueError("A group username is required")
 85        identity = {"username": username, "server_url": server_address(server_url)}
 86        with self.connection:
 87            current = self.identity
 88            if current is not None and current != identity:
 89                raise ValueError("This database belongs to another group or server")
 90            self.connection.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO metadata VALUES ('identity', ?)",
 91                                    (json.dumps(identity),))
 92
 93    @property
 94    def pending(self):
 95        row = self.connection.execute("SELECT payload FROM pending WHERE singleton=1").fetchone()
 96        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else None
 97
 98    @property
 99    def last_pull(self):
100        return self.connection.execute("SELECT MAX(pull) FROM results").fetchone()[0]
101
102    def results(self):
103        for row in self.connection.execute("SELECT * FROM results ORDER BY pull"):
104            yield {"Arm": str(row["arm"]), "Reward": row["reward"],
105                   "NetReward": row["net_reward"], "Pull": row["pull"]}
106
107    def aggregate(self):
108        """At most 24 rows; SQLite handles history scanning with a bounded cache."""
109        return [dict(row) for row in self.connection.execute(
110            "SELECT arm, COUNT(*) AS pulls, SUM(reward) AS signups FROM results GROUP BY arm")]
111
112    def tuning_state(self):
113        row = self.connection.execute("SELECT value FROM metadata WHERE key='tuning_state'").fetchone()
114        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else None
115
116    def record_tuning(self, decision):
117        payload = json.dumps(decision, allow_nan=False, separators=(',', ':'))
118        with self.connection:
119            if self.pending is not None:
120                raise RuntimeError('Cannot change policy with an unresolved request')
121            self.connection.execute('INSERT INTO tuning_decisions(at_pull,payload) VALUES (?,?)',
122                                    (decision['at_pull'], payload))
123            self.connection.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO metadata VALUES ('tuning_state', ?)",
124                                    (payload,))
125
126    def _insert(self, result, model="imported", parameters=None, request_id=None):
127        if self.identity is None:
128            raise ValueError("Bind the group and server before saving real results")
129        row = normalize_result(result)
130        existing = self.connection.execute("SELECT * FROM results WHERE pull=?", (row["Pull"],)).fetchone()
131        if existing:
132            if (existing["arm"], existing["reward"], existing["net_reward"]) != (
133                    int(row["Arm"]), row["Reward"], row["NetReward"]):
134                raise ValueError("Conflicting results for the same pull index")
135            return False
136        self.connection.execute("INSERT INTO results VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
137                                (row["Pull"], int(row["Arm"]), row["Reward"], row["NetReward"],
138                                 timestamp(), model, json.dumps(parameters or {}, allow_nan=False), request_id))
139        return True
140
141    def append_result(self, result):
142        return bool(self.import_results([result]))
143
144    def import_results(self, results):
145        with self.connection:
146            if self.pending is not None:
147                raise RuntimeError("Resolve the pending online request before importing")
148            return sum(self._insert(result) for result in results)
149
150    def prepare(self, *, arm, expected_pull, model, parameters):
151        integer(arm, "arm", maximum=ARMS - 1)
152        integer(expected_pull, "expected_pull", maximum=MAX_PULLS - 1)
153        if self.identity is None:
154            raise ValueError("Bind the group before preparing requests")
155        payload = {"arm": arm, "expected_pull": expected_pull, "request_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
156                   "model": model, "parameters": parameters, "created_at": timestamp()}
157        with self.connection:
158            if self.pending is not None:
159                raise RuntimeError("Resolve the pending request first")
160            self.connection.execute("INSERT INTO pending VALUES (1, ?)",
161                                    (json.dumps(payload, allow_nan=False),))
162        return payload
163
164    def complete(self, result):
165        row = normalize_result(result)
166        with self.connection:
167            request = self.pending
168            if request is None or (int(row["Arm"]), row["Pull"]) != (
169                    request["arm"], request["expected_pull"]):
170                raise ValueError("Response does not match the pending request")
171            previous = self.connection.execute('SELECT net_reward FROM results WHERE pull=?',
172                                               (row['Pull']-1,)).fetchone()
173            if (previous is not None and row['NetReward'] != previous[0]+row['Reward']) or (
174                    row['Pull'] == 0 and row['NetReward'] != row['Reward']):
175                raise ValueError('Response cumulative reward does not match saved history')
176            inserted = self._insert(row, request["model"], request["parameters"], request["request_id"])
177            self.connection.execute("DELETE FROM pending WHERE singleton=1")
178        return inserted
179
180    def _cancel_unsent(self, request_id):
181        """Runner-only: caller must prove HTTP transmission has never started."""
182        with self.connection:
183            request = self.pending
184            if request is None or request["request_id"] != request_id:
185                raise RuntimeError("Cannot cancel a different pending request")
186            self.connection.execute("DELETE FROM pending WHERE singleton=1")
187
188    def export_jsonl(self, target):
189        target = Path(target).expanduser().resolve()
190        if target == self.path or target == self.path.with_suffix(self.path.suffix + ".lock"):
191            raise ValueError("Export must not overwrite the database or lock")
192        count = 0
193        # Exclusive creation protects existing exports/logs from accidental replacement.
194        with target.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
195            for row in self.results():
196                handle.write(json.dumps(row) + "\n")
197                count += 1
198        return count

 3import math
 4import threading
 5import time
 6
 7import server_pull
 8
 9from .common import server_address

11_HELPER_LOCK = threading.Lock()
12
13
14def validate_settings(interval, timeout):
15    for value, name, minimum, maximum in ((interval, "interval", 0.25, None),
16                                          (timeout, "timeout", 0, 60)):
17        if (isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
18                or not math.isfinite(value) or value < minimum
19                or (name == "timeout" and value == 0)
20                or (maximum is not None and value > maximum)):
21            raise ValueError("Invalid {}".format(name))
22
23
24class PacedClient:
25    def __init__(self, username, password, server_url, *, interval=0.25, timeout=10.0):
26        validate_settings(interval, timeout)
27        if not isinstance(username, str) or not username.strip():
28            raise ValueError("A group username is required for online mode")
29        if not isinstance(password, str) or not password:
30            raise ValueError("A group password is required for online mode")
31        self.username, self.password = username, password
32        self.server_url = server_address(server_url)
33        self.interval, self.timeout = interval, timeout
34        self._call_lock = threading.Lock()
35        # Also pace the first call after reopening a driver.
36        self._not_before = time.monotonic() + interval
37
38    def __enter__(self):
39        if not _HELPER_LOCK.acquire(blocking=False):
40            raise RuntimeError("Another online driver is already using the cloud helper")
41        try:
42            # Reconfiguration would discard state or reject a same-session pending request.
43            if server_pull.BASE_URL != self.server_url:
44                server_pull.configure(self.server_url)
45            # A client can be constructed long before another driver finishes.
46            # Start its initial guard when ownership is actually acquired.
47            self._not_before = max(self._not_before, time.monotonic() + self.interval)
48        except BaseException:
49            _HELPER_LOCK.release()
50            raise
51        return self
52
53    def __exit__(self, *args):
54        self.password = None
55        _HELPER_LOCK.release()
56
57    def _call(self, function, *args, before_send=None, **kwargs):
58        # Keep waiting, dispatch, and the whole response inside one lock. A slow
59        # call can use up the interval, but must never overlap the next call.
60        with self._call_lock:
61            while True:
62                delay = self._not_before - time.monotonic()
63                if delay <= 0:
64                    break
65                time.sleep(delay)
66            if before_send is not None:
67                before_send()
68            # Schedule from the actual start, never an old planned time. Network
69            # and local work count toward spacing; late calls cannot cause bursts.
70            self._not_before = time.monotonic() + self.interval
71            return function(self.username, self.password, *args, timeout=self.timeout, **kwargs)
72
73    def status(self):
74        return self._call(server_pull.status)
75
76    def pull(self, request, *, before_send=None):
77        return self._call(server_pull.pull, request["arm"],
78                          request_id=request["request_id"], expected_pull=request["expected_pull"],
79                          before_send=before_send)
80
81    def wait_before_retry(self):
82        with self._call_lock:
83            self._not_before = max(self._not_before, time.monotonic() + 1.0)
