1098def results(ctx):
1099    df, final, leader, arms, stages = ctx["df"], ctx["final"], ctx["leader"], ctx["arms"], ctx["stages"]
1100    n, signups = len(df), int(df["reward"].sum())
1101    # Stage table
1102    rows, classes = [], {}
1103    for i, s in enumerate(stages):
1104        rows.append([esc(s["label"]), "{:,}–{:,}".format(s["first"], s["last"]), "{:,}".format(s["pulls"]),
1105                     "{:,}".format(s["signups"]), pct(s["signups"] / (V * s["pulls"])), ("&gt;99.99%" if .99995 <= s["on_leader"] < 1 else pct(s["on_leader"], 2)),
1106                     str(s["arms"]), esc(s["method"]), "{:.2f}".format(s["speed"]), "{:,.0f}".format(s["cost"]),
1107                     esc(date_span(s["start"], s["end"]))])
1108    rows.append(["Total", "0–{:,}".format(n - 1), "{:,}".format(n), "{:,}".format(signups), pct(signups / (V * n)),
1109                 pct(float((df["arm"] == leader).mean()), 1), str(df["arm"].nunique()), "", "",
1110                 "{:,.0f}".format(sum(s["cost"] for s in stages)), esc(date_span(df["time"].iloc[0], df["time"].iloc[-1]))])
1111    classes[len(rows) - 1] = "total"
1112    stage_html = table(["Stage", "Pull numbers", "Pulls", "Sign-ups", "Conversion", "On arm {}".format(leader),
1113                        "Arms used", "Method", "Pulls per second", "Est. cost vs arm {}".format(leader), "Dates (SGT)"],
1114                       rows, "LRrrrrrLrrL", classes)
1115    # Allocation and conversion
1116    others = arms.drop(index=leader).sort_values("pulls", ascending=False)
1117    runners = [int(a) for a in others.index[:2]]
1118    bins = allocation_bins(df, leader, runners)
1119    marks = [(CHECKPOINTS[0], "{:,}".format(CHECKPOINTS[0])), (CHECKPOINTS[1], "{:,}".format(CHECKPOINTS[1])),
1120             (ctx["continuous_start"], "continuous run")]
1121    switches = [d for d in ctx["tuning"] if d["selected_multiplier"] != d["baseline_multiplier"]]
1122    marks += [(d["at_pull"], "×{:g}".format(d["selected_multiplier"])) for d in switches]
1123    switch_note = "".join(" After check {} switched to ×{:g} at pull {:,}, {} pull went to arm {}.".format(
1124        ctx["tuning"].index(d) + 1, d["selected_multiplier"], d["at_pull"],
1125        "every" if (df["arm"].iloc[d["at_pull"]:] == leader).all() else "almost every", leader) for d in switches)
1126    conv = conversion_bins(df)
1127    # Arms now
1128    arm_rows, arm_classes = [], {}
1129    for i, (arm, r) in enumerate(arms.sort_values("rate", ascending=False).iterrows()):
1130        gap = "" if arm == leader else "{:.2f} pts (z = {:.1f})".format(100 * r["gap"], r["z"])
1131        arm_rows.append([str(arm), "{:,}".format(int(r["pulls"])), pct(r["pulls"] / n, 3), "{:,}".format(int(r["signups"])),
1132                         pct(r["rate"], 3), "{} to {}".format(pct(r["low"], 3), pct(r["high"], 3)), gap, p_label(r["p_best"])])
1133        if arm == leader:
1134            arm_classes[i] = "hl"
1135    runner = int(others.sort_values("rate", ascending=False).index[0])
1136    rr = arms.loc[runner]
1137    p_beat = 0.5 * math.erfc(rr["z"] / math.sqrt(2))
1138    # Stability
1139    blocks, test = leader_stability(df, leader)
1140    noise_ratio = use_function("phase1/main.py", "noise_ratio", mean=mean, variance=variance, VISITORS_PER_PULL=V)
1141    stability = use_function("phase1/main.py", "stability", mean=mean, math=math, VISITORS_PER_PULL=V)
1142    by_arm = df.groupby("arm")["reward"].apply(list).reindex(range(K)).tolist()
1143    ratio, dof = noise_ratio(by_arm)
1144    scores, overall = stability(by_arm)
1145    stab_out = ("Leading arm {arm}: {pulls:,} pulls, rate {rate}.\n"
1146                "Chi-square across the 20 windows: {chi2:.1f} on {dof} degrees of freedom, p = {p:.2f} "
1147                "(a small p would mean the rate changed).\n"
1148                "Batch dispersion: {disp:.3f} times binomial (about 1 ± {tol:.3f} is normal).\n"
1149                "Phase 1 checks rerun on all {n:,} pulls: noise {ratio:.3f} times binomial; {moved} of {arms} arms moved "
1150                "by more than 2 standard errors between the first and second half of their pulls; all arms together "
1151                "{overall:+.1f}.").format(
1152        arm=leader, pulls=int(arms.at[leader, "pulls"]), rate=pct(test["rate"], 3), chi2=test["chi2"],
1153        dof=test["dof"], p=test["p_value"], disp=test["dispersion"], tol=test["tolerance"], n=n, ratio=ratio,
1154        moved=sum(abs(s) > 2 for s in scores), arms=len(scores), overall=overall)
1155    # Integrity
1156    checks = ctx["integrity"]
1157    replay = ctx["replay"]
1158    check_lines = ["{} {}".format("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", text) for text, ok in checks]
1159    check_lines.append("{} Every one of the {:,} saved UCB choices matches a replay of UCBModel from the data before "
1160                       "it ({:,} differ)".format("PASS" if replay["mismatched"] == 0 else "FAIL", replay["checked"],
1161                                                 replay["mismatched"]))
1162    pending = ctx["pending"]
1163    check_lines.append("Pending request when this file was exported: {}".format(
1164        "none" if pending is None else "pull {:,} on arm {}, in flight while the driver runs (expected)".format(
1165            pending["expected_pull"], pending["arm"])))
1166    # Finish
1167    lead = arms.loc[leader]
1168    if final:
1169        cost = sum(s["cost"] for s in stages)
1170        finish_html = """
1171<h3 id="final">Our final result</h3>
1172<div class="callout">We used all {n:,} pulls and recorded <strong>{s:,} sign-ups</strong> from {v:,} visitors, an
1173overall conversion rate of {rate}. <strong>We choose arm {arm}.</strong> Its conversion rate is {lr} (95% interval
1174{lo} to {hi}) over {lp:,} pulls, and its posterior probability of being the best arm is {pb}. The closest
1175alternative, arm {runner}, is {gap:.2f} percentage points behind (z = {z:.1f}). Compared with sending every pull to
1176arm {arm} from the start, our approach gave up an estimated {cost:,.0f} sign-ups ({share} of the total), {pilot:,.0f}
1177of them in the 240-pull pilot.</div>""".format(
1178            n=n, s=signups, v=V * n, rate=pct(signups / (V * n)), arm=leader, lr=pct(lead["rate"], 3),
1179            lo=pct(lead["low"], 3), hi=pct(lead["high"], 3), lp=int(lead["pulls"]), pb=p_label(lead["p_best"]),
1180            runner=runner, gap=100 * rr["gap"], z=rr["z"], cost=cost, share=pct(cost / signups, 3),
1181            pilot=stages[0]["cost"])
1182    else:
1183        pr = projection(df)
1184        finish_html = """
1185<h3 id="remaining">Remaining budget</h3>
1186<p>When we exported this file, {left:,} pulls were still to be made. If they run at the recent speed and convert
1187like our last 100,000 pulls, we expect:</p>
1188{out}
1189{an}""".format(
1190            left=pr["remaining"],
1191            out=output(("Recent speed: {:.2f} pulls per second.\nForecast finish: {} Singapore time (pulls close {}).\n"
1192                        "Forecast total sign-ups: about {:,.0f} ± {:,.0f}, at {} per pull.\n"
1193                        "This is a forecast, not a result.").format(
1194                pr["speed"], when(pr["finish"], "%d %b %H:%M"), when(DEADLINE, "%d %b %H:%M"), pr["total"],
1195                pr["noise"], pct(pr["rate"], 3))),
1196            an=analysis_code("projection"))
1197    body = """
1198<p>All figures in this section are live results{asof}.</p>
1199<h3>Stage-level performance</h3>
1200<p>Stage 1 ran to our first checkpoint at {cp:,} pulls. Stage 2 covers the rest of our staged run up to the start
1201of the continuous run, and each later stage begins at one of the driver's tuning checks. The estimated cost column
1202shows how many sign-ups each stage gave up compared with sending every pull to arm {leader}, using our {est} rate
1203estimates: 100 × (arm {leader}'s rate − the pulled arm's rate), summed over the stage. Most of it comes from the
1204pilot, which sampled every arm evenly by design.</p>
1205{stage}
1206{an_stage}
1207<h3>Arm allocation</h3>
1208<p>As evidence built up, the share of our pulls not on arm {leader} fell steadily. UCB kept checking the
1209runners-up, arms {r1} and {r2}, while their scores could still overtake the leader's, and returned to them less
1210and less often.{switch_note} The pilot, which pulled every arm evenly, is not shown.</p>
1211{fig_alloc}
1212{an_alloc}
1213<h3>Conversion</h3>
1214<p>Our cumulative conversion rate climbed from the pilot's level towards arm {leader}'s own rate, which is the
1215most any method could achieve once arm {leader} is known to be best. The windowed rate reached that level early
1216and stayed there.</p>
1217{fig_conv}
1218{an_conv}
1219<h3>All 24 arms</h3>
1220<p>Arm {leader} received {share} of all our pulls. The runner-up by rate, arm {runner}, is {gap:.2f} points behind
1221(z = {z:.1f}), so under a normal approximation the chance that it is actually better is {pbeat}. P(best) uses
1222,000 joint draws from each arm's Beta posterior.</p>
1223{arm_table}
1224{an_arm}
1225<h3>Is the leading arm's rate stable?</h3>
1226<p>Step 0 showed that changing rates were the main risk to our approach, so we split the run into 20 equal
1227windows of the pull number and tested whether a single fixed rate explains arm {leader}'s results in all of
1228them.</p>
1229{fig_stab}
1230{stab}
1231{an_stab}
1232<h3>Data checks</h3>
1233<p>Before relying on these results, we checked that our saved history is complete and consistent:</p>
1234{checks}
1235{an_checks}
1236{finish}
1237""".format(
1238        asof="" if final else " for pulls 0 to {:,}, except the forecast at the end".format(n - 1), leader=leader,
1239        stage=stage_html, cp=CHECKPOINTS[0], est="final" if final else "latest",
1240        an_stage=analysis_code("stage_table"), r1=runners[0], r2=runners[1], switch_note=switch_note,
1241        fig_alloc=figure(chart_allocation(bins, leader, runners, marks), "Share of pulls not on arm {}".format(leader),
1242                         "Log-spaced windows of the pull number, both axes on a log scale. Vertical lines mark our "
1243                         "checkpoints, the start of the continuous run{}. A window with no such pulls leaves a gap.".format(
1244                             "".join(" and the switch to ×{:g}".format(d["selected_multiplier"]) for d in switches))),
1245        an_alloc=analysis_code("allocation_bins"),
1246        fig_conv=figure(chart_conversion(conv, leader, arms.at[leader, "rate"]), "Conversion rate over the run",
1247                        "The single point on the left is the pilot (pulls 0 to 239), which sampled every arm evenly; "
1248                        "after it, windows are log-spaced in the pull number. The horizontal line is arm {}'s rate "
1249                        "over all its pulls.".format(leader)),
1250        an_conv=analysis_code("conversion_bins"),
1251        share=pct(arms.at[leader, "pulls"] / n, 2), runner=runner, gap=100 * rr["gap"], z=rr["z"],
1252        pbeat="less than one in a million" if p_beat < 1e-6 else "about {:.2g}".format(p_beat),
1253        arm_table=table(["Arm", "Pulls", "Share of pulls", "Sign-ups", "Rate", "95% interval",
1254                         "Behind arm {}".format(leader), "P(best)"], arm_rows, "rrrrrrrr", arm_classes),
1255        an_arm=analysis_code("arm_summary", "leader_of"),
1256        fig_stab=figure(chart_stability(blocks, test["rate"]), "Arm {}'s rate in 20 windows of the run".format(leader),
1257                        "Each point is arm {}'s rate within one window of {:,} pull numbers, with its 95% interval. "
1258                        "The horizontal line is its overall rate.".format(
1259                            leader, int(blocks["last"].iloc[0] - blocks["first"].iloc[0] + 1))),
1260        stab=output(stab_out), an_stab=analysis_code("leader_stability"),
1261        checks=output("\n".join(check_lines)), an_checks=analysis_code("integrity_checks", "replay_ucb"),
1262        finish=finish_html)
1263    return section("results", "Results" + ("" if final else " so far"), "Live data", body, live=True)

1266def prompts_section():

1274            step=esc(g["step"]), dates=esc(g["dates"]), summary=esc(g["summary"]), link=g["links_to"],
1275            count=len(g["prompts"]), quotes=quotes))

1277        quotes = "".join('<blockquote class="prompt"><span class="when">{}</span>{}</blockquote>'.format(
1278            esc(t), esc(text)) for t, text in m["prompts"])
1279        groups.append("<h3>{} <span class=\"dates\">{}</span></h3><p>{}</p>{}".format(
1280            esc(m["step"]), esc(m.get("member", "")), esc(m["summary"]), quotes))
1281    body = """
1282<p>We used <strong>{tool}</strong> with <strong>{model}</strong> as a coding and analysis assistant. We used it to
1283write and review our simulators and live drivers, run the local simulations, help us interpret results, and draft
1284documentation and this file. We made the decisions on the method, its settings and when to spend pulls ourselves.
1285{coverage}</p>
1286<p>For each project step below, we summarise what we asked the LLM to do and list representative prompts. We have
1287edited these prompts for spelling, grammar and clarity; the substance of each request is unchanged, and our
1288original prompts are available on request. Where we included group notes in a prompt, we describe them in
1289brackets instead of repeating them. None of our prompts contains our group password.</p>
1290{groups}
1291""".format(tool=esc(llm_prompts.TOOL), model=esc(llm_prompts.MODEL), coverage=esc(llm_prompts.COVERAGE),
1292           groups="".join(groups))
1293    return section("prompts", "Appendix A: LLM use and prompts", "", body)

1312def source_section():
1313    items = []
1314    for rel, what in SOURCE_FILES:
1315        if not (REPO / rel).is_file():
1316            continue
1317        block = excerpt(rel)
1318        items.append(code(block, "{} · {:,} lines".format(what, block["end"]), open_=False))

1320<p>The complete source code of every file used above (click a file name to expand it). We used the teaching
1321team's <code>server_pull.py</code> and <code>GP3 Starter.ipynb</code> unchanged, so we do not repeat them here. Our
1322unit tests in <code>program/tests</code> check the drivers against a fake server and never contact the live one.</p>
1323{}
1324<p>Final-run data are available in <code>phase3/results/</code>: <code>final_pulls.csv.gz</code>, <code>final_summary.json</code> and <code>tuning_decisions.json</code>.</p>
1325<p>Rebuilding the full page with <code>report/build_report.py</code> requires the complete results database, event log and pre-pilot simulation outputs. The SQLite database bundled in the repository is the earlier 15,055-pull snapshot.</p>""".format("".join(items))
1326    return section("source", "Appendix B: full source files", "", body)

1428def refuse_secrets(text):
1429    """Never write a page that contains the group password, if it is set in this environment."""
1430    secret = os.environ.get("GP3_PASSWORD")
1431    if secret and secret in text:
1432        raise SystemExit("Refusing to write the page: it contains the GP3_PASSWORD value.")
1433
1434
1435def main():
1436    setup_charts()
1437    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
1438        copy = Path(tmp) / "snapshot.sqlite3"
1439        snapshot(copy)
1440        df, pending, tuning = load_data(copy)
1441    print("Snapshot: {:,} pulls, last saved {} SGT".format(len(df), when(df["time"].iloc[-1])), flush=True)
1442    runs = live_runs(LOG_PATH)
1443    arms = arm_summary(df, draws=200_000)
1444    leader = leader_of(arms)
1445    rate = arms["rate"]
1446    se = np.sqrt(rate * (1 - rate) / (V * arms["pulls"]))
1447    arms["gap"] = rate[leader] - rate
1448    arms["z"] = arms["gap"] / np.sqrt(se ** 2 + se[leader] ** 2)
1449    final = len(df) >= MAX_PULLS or (bool(runs) and runs[-1]["end"] is not None
1450                                     and datetime.now(SGT) > DEADLINE)
1451    continuous_start = tuning[0]["at_pull"] if tuning else 16_055
1452    ctx = {"df": df, "pending": pending, "tuning": tuning, "runs": runs, "arms": arms, "leader": leader,
1453           "final": final, "continuous_start": continuous_start,
1454           "pilot": arm_summary(df.iloc[:PILOT_PULLS]),
1455           "tuning_state_next": tuning[-1].get("next_at") if tuning else None}
1456    ctx["stages"] = stage_table(df, tuning, leader, final)
1457    ctx["integrity"] = integrity_checks(df)
1458    print("Replaying every UCB choice...", flush=True)
1459    ctx["replay"] = replay_ucb(df)
1460    sections = [header(ctx), overview(ctx), step0(ctx), step1(ctx), step2(ctx), step3(ctx), step4(ctx),
1461                results(ctx), prompts_section(), source_section()]
1462    text = page(sections)
1463    refuse_secrets(text)
1464    OUT_PATH.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
1465    print("Wrote {} ({:,} KB). UCB replay: {:,} checked, {:,} differ.".format(
1466        OUT_PATH, len(text.encode("utf-8")) // 1024, ctx["replay"]["checked"], ctx["replay"]["mismatched"]))
1467    # Group-only reminders. They are printed here, never written into the page.
1468    if not final:
1469        print("Reminder: the live run isn't finished ({:,} of {:,} pulls). Rebuild after it ends so the page "
1470              "shows the final totals and chosen arm.".format(len(df), MAX_PULLS))
1471    if not llm_prompts.OTHER_MEMBERS and not getattr(llm_prompts, "OTHER_MEMBERS_CONFIRMED", False):
1472        print("Reminder: Appendix A only has prompts from one member's sessions. Add other members' prompts to "
1473              "OTHER_MEMBERS in report/llm_prompts.py, or set OTHER_MEMBERS_CONFIRMED = True.")
1474
1475
1476if __name__ == "__main__":
1477    main()
report/llm_prompts.pyOur prompt summary for Appendix A · 154 lines
  1"""Our LLM prompts for GP3, summarised by project step. build_report.py renders this file as Appendix A.
  2
  3Each listed prompt is one we actually sent, edited for spelling, grammar and clarity, with
  4the substance of the request unchanged. Group notes included in a prompt are described in
  5brackets rather than repeated. No prompt contains the group password.
  6
  7Prompts from other members' sessions go in OTHER_MEMBERS, in the same shape as a GROUPS
  8entry plus a "member" key.
  9"""
 10
 11TOOL = "Claude Code (VS Code extension)"
 12MODEL = "Claude Opus 5.5"
 13COVERAGE = ("Our prompts come from 10 Claude Code sessions between 30 October and 14 November 2026, "
 14            "110 prompts in total.")
 15
 16GROUPS = [
 17    {
 18        "step": "Planning and method screening",
 19        "links_to": "step0",
 20        "dates": "30 Oct to 1 Nov",
 21        "summary": ("Before spending any of the budget, we asked whether simulation could guide our choice of "
 22                    "method when the true conversion rates are unknown. We then had the LLM build a local "
 23                    "simulator, with no access to the server, comparing the methods in our group plan with two "
 24                    "further methods from the lecture slides across several invented scenarios. We also used it "
 25                    "to explain the results, turn our plan into a flow chart, and identify signals during the "
 26                    "live run that would justify changing method."),
 27        "prompts": [
 28            ("30 Oct 22:14", "Review the project handout, the starter notebook and server_pull.py. Before we make "

Final-run data are available in phase3/results/: final_pulls.csv.gz, final_summary.json and tuning_decisions.json.

Rebuilding the full page with report/build_report.py requires the complete results database, event log and pre-pilot simulation outputs. The SQLite database bundled in the repository is the earlier 15,055-pull snapshot.
